description: Intel has reportedly increased prices across several processor lineups. Intel Panther Lake processors are seeing increases of 15 percent to 20 percent. Meteor Lake and Arrow Lake models reportedly rose by 5 percent to 10 percent. Qualcomm has raised prices for its multi-chip platforms. AMD is also said to be considering price adjustments for select processors. Demand for AI PCs and servers, along with advanced manufacturing process costs, is driving up CPU prices.
title: Intel, Qualcomm Raise CPU Prices Amid AI Demand, Panther Lake Processors See Steepest Hike: Report

description: Sui Foundation has committed $30 million to DATA Network as part of a partnership to bring its AI training data infrastructure to Sui. The transition will integrate DATA’s Trace registry into Sui, with Walrus becoming the default storage system for applications operated by DATA Foundation. The project’s standalone blockchain will shut down after migration, although the organisations have yet to announce a timeline or disclose the investment’s full financial terms.
title: Sui Commits $30 Million as DATA Network Winds Down Blockchain

description: Payward, the parent company of Kraken, has received Full Market Approval from Dubai’s Virtual Assets Regulatory Authority to provide regulated cryptocurrency services to retail, professional, and institutional clients in the UAE. Planned offerings include spot and margin trading in UAE dirhams, institutional over-the-counter services, and access to Kraken Prime. The company has not announced a launch date or confirmed which cryptocurrencies will have dirham-denominated trading pairs.
title: Kraken Parent Payward Gets Full Dubai Licence to Expand in UAE

description: Entering through a licensing partnership with Brandverse, the brand’s first Indian audio range spans portable Bluetooth speakers, a party speaker, Dolby Atmos soundbars and a home theatre system.
title: Schneider Brings 90 Years of French Consumer Electronics Heritage to India With a New Audio Range

description: Ledger has confirmed finding an unauthorised hardware component inside a customer’s cryptocurrency wallet amid an ongoing investigation into suspected thefts linked to CryptoBilis, a Southeast Asian reseller. Blockchain analytics firm Bitquery estimated that $92.9 million was taken from 311 wallets, although Ledger has not validated the reported losses or established a link between the hardware implant and the thefts. CryptoBilis has suspended hardware wallet sales.
title: Ledger Addresses Hidden Chip Concerns as Users Claim $92 Million in Crypto Theft

description: The Optoma UHR90DV combines 4K DLP projection with an RGB triple-laser engine, 5,000-lumen brightness and 96 percent BT.2020 colour coverage. It also supports Dolby Vision, HDR10+, IMAX Enhanced and Filmmaker Mode, along with motorised lens controls and HDMI 2.1. At Rs. 15,90,000, does it make sense to invest such a hefty amount in a 4K projector? Check out the review to know more about the latest 4K projector from Optoma.
title: Optoma UHR90DV Triple Laser RGB Projector Review: Bold, Bright and Not for Everyone

description: iQOO is preparing to launch the iQOO 16 in India as rising memory costs and supply constraints continue to pressure smartphone prices. In an exclusive interaction with Gadgets 360, Nipun Marya discussed the challenges facing the industry and the company's plans to offer a more complete flagship experience. He explained why iQOO wants to move beyond its gaming-focused image without compromising on performance. Marya also spoke about the brand's approach to reaching technology enthusiasts across India, the importance of community feedback, and what consumers can expect from the upcoming iQOO 16.
title: iQOO's Nipun Marya on Smartphone Price Hikes and Why iQOO 16 is a "Complete Flagship"

description: Oppo has teased the Pad Mini Matte Display Edition for the Indian market, revealing key features ahead of its launch. The tablet will offer a Snapdragon 8 Gen 5 chipset, an 8,000mAh battery and a 144Hz matte OLED display. It will feature an 8.8-inch 2.5K screen with 2.99mm bezels. The Chinese variant comes with up to 12GB of RAM, 512GB of storage and 67W wired charging. Oppo has yet to confirm the Indian model’s pricing, launch date and full specifications.
title: Oppo Pad Mini Key Features Revealed Ahead of India Launch

description: OnePlus 16 has been launched in China as the tech firm’s new flagship smartphone. The handset succeeds last year's OnePlus 15. The new OnePlus 16 will be available for purchase in the country via the Oppo China online store. It is offered in Tomorrow's Star, Martian Masterpiece, and Dark Forest (translated from Chinese) colourways. The phone will go on sale in 12GB + 512GB, 16GB + 512GB, and 16GB + 1TB RAM and storage configurations. The OnePlus 16 is powered by an octa-core Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 chipset from Qualcomm, which is built on a 2nm process. The handset also packs a 9,000mAh battery and a triple rear camera unit.
title: OnePlus 16 Launched With 9,000mAh Battery, Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 Chipset: Price, Specifications

description: Amazon Great Indian Festival Sale 2026 started last week in India. Customers planning to buy Amazon Echo smart speakers and Echo smart displays with Alexa can take advantage of the ongoing offers. Here are the best offers on Amazon Echo Devices and Alexa Speakers available during the Amazon Great Indian Festival 2026. Final prices and savings may vary depending on payment methods and exchange value.
title: Amazon Great Indian Festival Sale 2026: Best Deals on Echo Devices and Alexa Speakers

description: WhatsApp's upcoming message scheduling tool could make it easier to plan conversations and send messages at the right time. Spotted in Android beta version 2.26.40.7, the feature reportedly lets users choose when text messages, links and media should be delivered. It may also include a dedicated section for managing pending messages and support end-to-end encryption. Users could schedule messages up to two weeks ahead, with group message delivery tied to membership at the time of scheduling. The rollout remains limited for now.
title: WhatsApp May Soon Let Android Users Schedule Messages, Photos and Videos

description: Acer Iconia Tab 11 5G and Iconia Tab 12 5G were launched in India on Monday. The new Acer tablets feature 90Hz displays. They are powered by an octa-core processor from MediaTek and ship with 8GB of RAM. The Iconia Tab 11 5G features a 10.95-inch display, while the Iconia Tab 12 5G sports a larger 12.2-inch screen with higher resolution. Both models also support expandable storage and fingerprint recognition.
title: Acer Iconia Tab 11 5G, Iconia Tab 12 5G Launched in India With 90Hz Displays: Price, Specifications

description: Oppo's F-series has completed 10 years in India, crossing 30 million users along the way. What started as a selfie-focused smartphone lineup has gradually evolved to offer better battery life, durability, performance, and imaging capabilities. In an exclusive interaction with Gadgets 360, Goldee Patnaik, Head of Communications at Oppo India, discussed the series' evolution and the company's renewed focus on group photography with the F35 Series. He also spoke about the growing creator economy, changing smartphone upgrade cycles, AI-powered features, and Oppo's expanding after-sales service network. Here's how Oppo plans to take its F Series forward in India.
title: 10 Years, 30 Million Users: How Oppo F Series Evolved From Selfie Expert to Creator Hub

description: iQOO has outlined when its smartphones in India will receive OriginOS 7, with the rollout starting with the iQOO 15 by the end of October 2026. The iQOO 15R and iQOO 13 are next in November, followed by select iQOO 12, Neo and Z series models through February 2027. Based on Android 17, OriginOS 7 adds multitasking tools, AI features through Jovi, cross-device connectivity, customisation options and security controls. Vivo smartphones will also receive the update.
title: iQOO OriginOS 7 Update Timeline Revealed for India: Check Eligible Phones

description: Amazon Great Indian Festival Sale 2026 is offering discounts on smart TVs with a 75-inch display. For reference, you can get TCL’s 75-inch 4K QLED Ultra HD Smart TV at a discounted price of Rs. 70,990, instead of its listed price of Rs. 1,61,990. Similarly, you can get your hands on Xiaomi’s FX series 75-inch 4K QD-Mini LED Smart TV at a relatively low price of Rs. 71,999. On top of direct price cuts, the Amazon Great Indian Festival Sale 2026 is also offering an instant discount of 10 percent with SBI credit and debit cards and SBI credit card EMI transactions. You can also avail a cashback of 5 percent with an Amazon Pay ICICI Bank credit card or a flat Rs. 50 cashback with Amazon Pay UPI transactions.
title: Amazon Great Indian Festival 2026: Top Deals on 75-Inch and More Smart TVs From Sony, TCL and Samsung

description: iQOO's Neo 12 smartphone will launch in China this month. The Vivo sub-brand has also opened pre-orders for the iQOO Neo 12 and iQOO Pad Pro Mini tablet ahead of their official debut. The iQOO Neo 12 is confirmed to feature a 2K display with a 185Hz refresh rate. It will run on the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 chipset and a new active cooling system.
title: iQOO Neo 12, iQOO Pad Pro Mini Launch Teased; Key Specifications Revealed

description: Amazon Great Indian Festival Sale 2026 is offering various laptops from Asus, HP, Lenovo, and Dell at discounted prices. The Amazon Great Indian Festival Sale 2026 is offering the Asus Zenbook 14 (2026) at a discounted price of Rs. 1,24,990, coming down from its listed price of Rs. 1,91,900, marking a discount of Rs. 67,000. On the other hand, the HP 14 model with the Intel Core Ultra 5 processor is listed on the e-commerce platform at a relatively low price of Rs. 89,990, instead of its listed price of Rs. 1,39,201. The e-commerce giant is offering an instant discount of 10 percent with SBI credit and debit cards and SBI credit card EMI transactions.
title: Amazon Great Indian Festival 2026: Best Asus, HP, Lenovo and Dell Laptop Deals

description: Amazon Great Indian Festival Sale 2026 started last week with heavy price cuts across major smartphone categories. Here is a list of the best deals on premium and flagship smartphones from Samsung, Vivo, Apple, iQOO and others that you can grab during the ongoing sale. Some of the figures mentioned include bank discounts.
title: Amazon Great Indian Festival Sale 2026: Best Deals on Premium and Flagship Smartphones

description: Vivo’s upcoming X500 E smartphone has surfaced on two certification platforms, with its Google Play Console listing revealing the model number V2656 and device code V2648. The latter matches the Vivo V80 5G, fuelling speculation that the two phones could share a hardware platform. Bluetooth SIG has also listed the X500 E under the same model number but has not disclosed its specifications. Rumours point to a Dimensity 9500 chipset, a 64-megapixel periscope camera and a 7,500mAh battery.
title: Vivo X500 E Surfaces on Bluetooth SIG, Google Play Console Ahead of Anticipated Launch

description: Oppo Find X10 series will be announced in India on October 22, according to a tipster. Additionally, the Bank of Electronics website in India has listed the Oppo Find X10 Pro Max, revealing the smartphone's price. The handset appears with a price tag of Rs. 1,28,990 for the base variant featuring 12GB of RAM and 256GB of onboard storage. It is also listed in a single Light Titanium colour option. The company has already confirmed that the Oppo Find X10 series will be launched in select global markets on October 21 at 4:00 pm CEST (7:30 pm IST). Similarly, the tech firm has also announced that the Oppo Enco X4 will be launched in India soon, along with the new Oppo Pad Mini. The Oppo Enco X4 TWS will feature adaptive ANC, while the Oppo Pad Mini will be offered in the Matte Display Edition.
title: Oppo Find X10 Pro Max Price in India Revealed via Early Listing as Tipster Hints at Launch Date: Specifications, Features

description: The Amazon Great Indian Festival Sale continues to bring great offers on a wide range of electronics. In the last few days, shoppers across the country have been taking full advantage of top discounts on home appliances and lifestyle gadgets. The e-commerce giant is offering aggressive price cuts on high-capacity air conditioners, making them more affordable ahead of the festive season. Offerings from brands like Hitachi, Samsung, LG, Godrej, IFB, and Carrier are listed with steep discounts, in addition to other offers.
title: Amazon Great Indian Festival 2026: Best 2-Ton AC Deals

description: Xiaomi 18 Pro and Xiaomi 18 Pro Max have reportedly appeared on the Geekbench AI benchmarking platform in their global variants. The listings suggest that international testing of both handsets is in the works, potentially hinting at an imminent global launch. The global variant of the Xiaomi 18 Pro carries the model number 2609BPN61G, while the Xiaomi 18 Pro Max has been identified by the model number 2611FPNFAG.
title: Xiaomi 18 Pro, 18 Pro Max Global Variants  Reportedly Spotted on Geekbench AI, Key Details Revealed

description: Cyberleek, the infamous group behind GTA 6 leaks in August, is back with a new 24-minute extended leak from the game. The group has also threatended to leak a full playable build of GTA 6 if Rockstar and Take-Two don't agree to its demands. The leaker demanded that Take-Two release a disc version of GTA 6.
title: Cyberleek Threatens to Leak Full Playable Build of GTA 6, Releases New 24-Minute Gameplay Clip

description: Planning to make your home smarter with a new robot vacuum cleaner? You've made a great choice. These devices eliminate the hassle of sweeping and mopping by automatically mapping your floors, scrubbing tiles, and handling dust disposal on their own. While they do cost generally more than traditional vacuum cleaners, the Amazon Great Indian Festival Sale offers great deals on offerings from top brands like Dreame, Ecovacs, Eureka Forbes, and ILIFE. You can grab these cleaning assistants at considerably lower prices than their usual market rates.
title: Amazon Great Indian Festival 2026: Best Robot Vacuum Deals

description: iPad Mini (2026) will be launched globally later this month at a significantly higher price than its predecessor, Bloomberg’s Mark Gurman writes in the latest edition of his weekly newsletter ‘Power On’. The compact tablet is expected to debut in the US with a price tag of about $799 (roughly Rs. 76,000), marking a $200 (about Rs. 19,000) jump from its current retail price of $599 (roughly Rs. 57,000) for the base model in the country. Further, the report highlights that the new iPad Mini (2026) will be equipped with an OLED display. If this is true, then it would be Apple’s first iPad Mini model to feature an OLED panel. On top of this, the compact tablet will reportedly be powered by the new A20 Pro chipset, which is built on a 2nm process. Similarly, the iPad Mini (2026) might sport a relocated FaceTime camera and an upgraded speaker setup.
title: iPad Mini (2026) With OLED Display to Reportedly Launch at a Significantly Higher Price Than Its Predecessor

description: Bitcoin has recovered to $84,000 as large-holder accumulation and corporate buying provide support despite institutional outflows. More than $2.4 billion (roughly Rs. 22,992 crore) in crypto positions were liquidated, while US spot Bitcoin ETFs ended a three-week run of inflows. Traders are now watching the $85,000 resistance level and the upcoming US CPI release for clues about the market’s next move.
title: Bitcoin Rebounds Above $84,000 as Whale Buying Counters ETF Outflows

description: After numerous leaks about Oppo’s upcoming foldable, new details have emerged about the phone’s display, design and cameras. A tipster claims Oppo’s unannounced Find N7 foldable will have a smaller display, a 200-megapixel primary camera, and a slim, lightweight design.
title: Oppo Find N7 Leaks Reveal Seamless 7.6-Inch Main Display, Slim Design and 200-Megapixel Main Camera

description: Oppo recently announced the upcoming launch of the Oppo Pad Mini Matte Display Edition and Oppo Enco X4 in India. While a launch date has yet to be announced, it is expected to closely align with the rollout of ColorOS 17, Oppo’s Android 17-based OS, set to begin on October 13. Ahead of their anticipated debut, the company has now teased some of the features of the Oppo Pad Mini Matte Display Edition and Oppo Enco X4.
title: Oppo Pad Mini Matte Display Edition, Oppo Enco X4 Features Teased Ahead of India Launch

description: With the iPhone 18 series now firmly in the rear-view mirror, the focus is shifting to the company’s smart home category. The Cupertino-based tech giant has announced an event for tomorrow, aptly named ‘Welcome Home’, where it is expected to unveil several new smart home products. The lineup reportedly includes the highly anticipated smart home display, while an updated Apple TV 4K and a refreshed HomePod mini could also be among the products that could be announced. The rumour mill also suggests that Apple is working on HomeKit accessories, although these products may not be ready yet.
title: What to Expect at Apple's October 13 Event: HomePad, New Apple TV, and More

description: Apple is preparing a big showcase for the iPhone Duo as the smartphone is scheduled to go on sale in select global markets on October 23, according to the Power On newsletter by Bloomberg's Mark Gurman. As part of the retail push, the tech giant is reportedly planning to ship “a huge number of demo units” to its flagship stores in the US. Apple’s Fifth Avenue store in New York City will reportedly receive more than 150 demo units for hands-on experience and in-store fixtures. On the other hand, the Apple Park Visitor Center in Cupertino is said to get about 100 demo units. Similarly, the Apple stores on Chicago’s Michigan Avenue, the Grove in Los Angeles, and the Upper West Side in Manhattan will reportedly receive about 30 to 40 units for hands-on experience and fixtures.
title: Apple Plans ‘Big’ iPhone Duo Retail Push Ahead of October 23 Sale, Report Says

description: Google Fitbit Edge will launch on October 12. The new fitness tracker is expected to sit between the Fitbit Air and the Pixel Watch 5 in Google's device lineup. The Fitbit Air-like fitness band is rumoured to feature an AMOLED display and built-in GPS. It could offer Gemini-powered personalised coaching. It will reportedly offer up to seven days of battery life on a single charge.
title: Google Fitbit Edge Set to Launch Today: Expected Price, Specifications

description: OnePlus 16 is all set to be launched in China today as the company’s latest flagship smartphone. Ahead of its anticipated debut, OnePlus has revealed several key specifications, including its display technology, gaming capabilities, charging speeds, and durability ratings. The OnePlus 16 is confirmed to feature a 185Hz display. It will have a 200-megapixel camera and run on Qualcomm’s new flagship mobile platform. The handset will pack a 9,000mAh battery.
title: OnePlus 16 Specifications Revealed Ahead of China Launch; to Get 200-Megapixel Camera, 2nm Snapdragon Chip

description: Apple is reportedly preparing to unveil its HomeView smart home hub at its October 13 event, with shipments expected to begin in mid-November. The device could arrive in countertop and wall-mounted variants, feature an A18 chip and use Siri for voice controls. Apple is also expected to introduce a new Apple TV 4K with an A19 chip and an updated HomePod mini. Both products could reach stores on October 30. Apple is reportedly exploring new smart home accessories with partners including LG.
title: Apple HomeView Smart Hub, New Apple TV 4K and HomePod mini Launch Timeline Leaks

description: More details about the OnePlus Ace 7 have now emerged on popular benchmarking website Geekbench. The listing reveals a device which the source claims is the upcoming OnePlus Ace 7, which could also be the OnePlus 16R, reportedly headed to India.
title: OnePlus Ace 7 Series Spotted on Geekbench With Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5, Android 17

description: Apple has announced a range of festive offers in India. As part of the campaign, the Cupertino-based tech giant is bringing a special edition of the AirPods 5, which sport a custom-designed rangoli engraving on the Wireless Charging Case. Apart from this, customers can access an online Rangoli creation experience for the first time. Apple has also announced festive offers on select products across iPhone, Mac, iPad, Apple Watch, and AirPods lineups.
title: Apple Festive Offers in India: Special Edition AirPods 5 With Rangoli Engraving, Offers on Select Products and More
